description: Poll for bid-outcome changes on a checked booking without re-running a status check: an ordered log of events (offer.status_changed, offer.accepted, offer.declined, offer.cancelled, checkout.paid) with the offer reference, new and previous status, amount and cabin. Pass the sessionId (or conversationId) and, on later calls, the `since` cursor from the previous response to get only what's new. Bids settle 24–72h before departure, so poll periodically (or subscribe via REST POST /api/v1/webhooks) instead of asking the traveler to check back. Empty means no change observed yet.

conversationId.description: Stable conversation id (reuses the last checked booking).

sessionId.description: The sessionId from start_eligibility_check. Optional if conversationId is passed.

since.description: Return only events after this: the `nextCursor` from a previous call, or an ISO-8601 timestamp.

name: get_offer_events
title: Get Offer Events
